title: Balanced Binary Tree
statement: Return true when the tree is height-balanced, meaning that at every node the two subtree heights differ by at most one.
hints: Computing height separately at every node re-walks the tree and gives O(n^2).
Instead have one recursion return the height AND signal imbalance in the same pass.
A common trick is returning -1 as a sentinel for already unbalanced, which then propagates straight up.
